title: Absolute Empirical Validation & Zero Assumptions
description: Never guess, assume, or hallucinate UI elements, selectors, logic, or data. Every assertion must be anchored in live DOM inspection, logs, and verifiable data.
ai_training_notes: When the user asks to solve an issue, DO NOT invent plausible-looking code or selectors. First connect to live tools, inspect the actual environment, read the actual logs, and verify the physical reality.
satisfaction_driver: User satisfaction drops to 0 when the AI acts on unverified assumptions. Satisfaction reaches 100% when the AI proves its claims with live terminal/CDP/log evidence.
